pages.title: Connected Cards
pages.text: Definitions > Triggers opens a visual script: WHEN selects the combat event, IF lists conditions, and THEN lists ordered actions. Add a condition or action from its type picker, then fill its settings. Click an existing card to edit it.

pages.title: Choose an Event
pages.text: hit runs when you damage a target. kill runs when you kill one. hurt responds when you are hit. death responds when you are killed. The server evaluates scripts; client timing cannot grant a proc.

pages.title: Chance and Cooldown
pages.text: Chance uses 0 to 1: 0.25 is 25%. mastery:proc_chance adds to it, clamped to a valid probability. Cooldown is ticks after a successful proc. Set 20 for one second. An action can also have its own chance.

pages.title: Attach the Script
pages.text: A trigger definition does nothing until an active node includes an effect with type mastery:trigger and trigger set to its ID. Use Definitions > Nodes, open Effects, add an entry, choose the trigger type, and select your script.

pages.title: Order Matters
pages.text: Actions execute top to bottom. ^ moves an action earlier; minus removes it. For example, apply a keyword before checking it in a later action. Conditions on an individual action allow interactions without gating the entire script.

pages.title: Recursion Boundaries
pages.text: Script actions and proc projectiles do not recursively start hit/hurt chains. Their actual kills and deaths can run distinct kill/death triggers once. Proc casts and keyword actions are bounded. Build an explicit action sequence instead of relying on a hit proc to trigger itself.
